name: adaptive-engineering
description: RSC Harness ported to Oh My Pi: deterministic guards, risk/spec/review gates and the original engineering skills, adapted at the ExtensionAPI boundary.

omp.description: RSC Harness for OMP: danger/branch/ship/gitmoji guards, risk, spec gate, review ledger, sello, and the suggest/ftd/asdd skills.

guards.danger.description: Guard de comandos irreversibles: pregunta o deniega según el perfil y el modo.

guards.branch.description: Guard de rama: troncal cerrada y aislamiento en worktrees.

guards.ship.description: Guard de entrega: sello, spec enlazada y limpieza de rama.

guards.gitmoji.description: Exige gitmoji al inicio del mensaje de commit.

danger.mode.description: Cómo decide el guard peligroso: auto hereda el perfil; ask pregunta; deny deniega. Nunca relaja un perfil no técnico.

scripts.test:all: node --test tests/*.test.js && bun tests/adapter.test.ts && bun run typecheck
